reviewer: Independent second-reading agent; same model family, not an independently credentialed human Tibetan editor

source.mapping: PDF page N = BDRC image N+2

scope: Focused second inspection of the 13 restored main verse lines, one restored heading, portrait caption, compressed PDF102 inscription, and U00039/U00542 corrections. No future chapters.

method.first_pass: Read AGENTS.md, source README, editorial method/status/handoff. Inspected existing images before opening the full proposed insertion/correction JSON records. Initial views included some adjacent lines; final locators were checked in page halves and freshly extracted native source images.
method.second_pass: Compared the exact proposed strings with the visible scan and inspected the corresponding clauses, both sides of physical row breaks, stack shapes and contextual layout.
method.new_extraction: PyMuPDF extracted the native embedded raster images from the source PDF; Pillow generated exact rectangular crops and display enlargements. No OCR or generated/retouched glyphs. Poppler executable could not load libpoppler.so.160, so existing/native extraction was used.
blindness_limits: Handoff had already disclosed stong, spras, sku, restored-line counts, and uncertainty locations.
The uncued pass did not yield complete trustworthy transcripts for every verse; final lexical confirmations are image-assisted comparisons, not successful blind transcription.
A second agent of the same model family is not independent human palaeographic expertise.
